lines.text: Get off Roblox right now, or I'm deleting your account!
Mom, please, just 1 minute! Just 1 minute!
Fine. You can play ONLY while my pizza warms up. You have 30 SECONDS!
I need to beat this stage to get the free Valkyrie hat! Faster, faster!
Give me your Robux or I tell Mom!
I made it! I got the reward!
Ouch! The crust is hot, but the inside is FROZEN ICE!
Thanks mom, time to buy the whole catalog!
